perprime-gcd-lexmonovariant.summary: Per-prime p-adic exponent tracking: d_p = gcd of exponent multiset (invariant, Euclidean identity) gives (b); (Ω,K) lexicographic monovariant gives (a) termination; d_p rules out all-ones terminus. Complete and correct modulo one arithmetic slip in the Ω-difference lemma (2Ω(g) should be Ω(g)).
